# AutoTester — snapshot (generated by `autotester snapshot`; do not edit)

**Purpose:** the whole project in one screen — what it is, what is live and why, what changed, what is next.
**Open me when:** every session start (the hook injects me); before picking a unit. For detail go to the router in `CLAUDE.md`.

## Product
Onboard any web product in one form (URL, scoped credentials, optional evals/rules/use cases/sources).
AutoTester learns its flows screen-by-screen, generates **best / worst / edge** cases, and runs in a
**real visible browser** after every dev cycle — so a new feature cannot silently break an old one.
When it meets a screen it does not know, it asks the human for a video instead of guessing.
North star: an expert human tester and AutoTester get the same material and the same build;
AutoTester wins on bugs found, false positives, and time (`schema/bench.py` computes that scorecard).

- F-047 **First-party API/network assertions during crawl and run** [high] — While a crawl or a test run drives the browser, AutoTester records every first-party API response (method, URL, status) as NETWORK evidence through the one existing response listener, scrubbing secrets from URLs before anything is stored; third-party calls are excluded. A test can now declare expected network calls and get a real met/unmet result, and crawl network evidence persists per crawl (crawl/<id>/network.jsonl). Capture only observes -- the grader still owns every verdict. · reason: Closes T-170 (D-040 split from T-165, built first because it needs no traversal work): a product's own 500s and failed calls become test evidence instead of passing silently behind a screen that looks fine. Single independent checker-PASS, NA1-NA6 each falsified in a throwaway copy. PREFILLED -- Umesh to confirm or edit.
- F-046 **Durable cross-run Portal Persona with change detection and dated history** [high] — Promotes the per-crawl screen graph and knowledge page into a durable, versioned PortalPersona artifact per project (schema/portal_persona.py) built by stages/portal_persona.py::build_portal_persona. Each rebuild diffs against the previous persona, records what changed with a dated history, and regenerates a human-readable knowledge view (stages/portal_persona_view.py); an identical rebuild records no change. It is an artifact plus a stage, not a new pipeline stage or datastore (D-038). · reason: Closes T-164 (D-038): AutoTester keeps what it learned about a portal across runs instead of relearning it every crawl, which the persona-seeded incremental crawl and change tracking in Umesh's 2026-09-23 direction build on. Single independent checker-PASS, PP1-PP6 each falsified in a throwaway copy. PREFILLED -- Umesh to confirm or edit.
